purpose: Resolve all exact current EIDOS vascular taxon IDs independently discovered in the 77 JBLR La Rioja 10x10 cells, to characterize what the distribucion_especies plantvas field actually represents.
notes: Exact-ID resolution only. No RC2 or existing JBLR/Rioja corpus is used as input, filter, hint, or validation source. Preserve unresolved IDs as unresolved; no name matching and no absence inference.
